hfInput.hint: Enter a HuggingFace model id (e.g. namespace/model) or paste a model URL.

resolving: Resolving model card and file listing…

license.modelCardNotice: No standard text exists for this license — the model card is shown instead. Review the license at the source before accepting.
license.noLicenseWarning: ⚠ No license specified by the model author. Proceed at your own risk.

ep.label: Execution provider
ep.pickHint: Pick the execution provider this model will run under.
ep.warning: ⚠ Wrong choice may crash the app on next embed.

import.notice: You’re importing a custom model. By using it, you assert that you have a license to do so.

done: The model is installed and ready to use.

failure.cancelled: The install was cancelled. Nothing was added to your models.
failure.cardFetchLead: The model card couldn’t be fetched.
failure.cardFetchHint: The license is fetched live to defend against post-curation edits, so we can’t proceed with a cached copy. Check your connection and try again.
failure.resolveLead: That HuggingFace model couldn’t be resolved.

downloadHint.network: The connection dropped. Downloaded files are kept, so a retry resumes where this left off.
downloadHint.disk: There isn’t enough free space. The partial download has been removed to reclaim it.
downloadHint.invalid-request: The download request was rejected. This looks like a problem with the bundled catalog rather than your device.
downloadHint.unknown: Downloaded files are kept, so a retry resumes where this left off.

failure.validationLead: This model doesn’t have the required ONNX exports.
failure.validationHint: Some models ship in Python-only formats (PyTorch / safetensors). Check the model card for ONNX export instructions, or try the curated catalog.
failure.hashMismatchLead: A downloaded file doesn’t match the expected hash: {{file}}
failure.hashMismatchHint: This can mean a corrupted download, or an upstream change the bundled catalog hasn’t caught up to. The files have been removed — retrying the same bytes wouldn’t help.
failure.verifyErrorLead: A downloaded file couldn’t be checked: {{file}}
failure.verifyErrorHint: The file itself may be fine — the check couldn’t run. Retrying resumes from what’s already downloaded.
failure.smokeTestLead: The model downloaded correctly but couldn’t be loaded.
failure.smokeTestHint: The files are intact but this device couldn’t run the model. Try a different model, or check the model card for supported hardware.
failure.persistLead: The model downloaded and verified, but couldn’t be saved.
failure.persistHint: Check available disk space and try again.
